title: Review and debate
sub: An independent reviewer, with its own retrieval, decides what to check and rejects a draft it did not verify.

steps.d: "What is the maximum vent run for the DR-520?"

steps.h: The author retrieves its own sources

steps.d:
"The DR-520's vent run is limited to 35 feet with
up to 4 elbows [dr520-manual#4]."

steps.h: The reviewer, independently, decides what to check
The reviewer's own search runs — not the author's
steps.d:
service-bulletin#1: "this bulletin revises the
maximum vent run specification for the DR-520
dryer. It does not affect the DR-210 …"

steps.h: The reviewer rejects, with a reason
steps.d:
"REJECT: the draft never checked for a superseding
bulletin, and one exists — service-bulletin#1
confirms this figure has since been revised."
